Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 1994
SINDH SPORTS BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
ACT VII OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Sports Board
Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
7th March 1994]
No.
PAS/Legis-15/93, dated 7-3-1994. The Sindh Sports Board (Amendment) Bill, 1993
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 26th December, 1993
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 2nd February, 1994 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Act may, be called the Sindh Sports Board (Amendment) Act, 1993.
(2) It shall
come into force on and from 31st August, 1993.

Amendment of section 4 of Sindh Ordinance VIII of 1980

ACT VII OF 1994
SINDH SPORTS BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
ACT VII OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Sports Board
Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
7th March 1994]
No.
PAS/Legis-15/93, dated 7-3-1994. The Sindh Sports Board (Amendment) Bill, 1993
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 26th December, 1993
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 2nd February, 1994 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 4 of Sindh
Ordinance VIII of 1980.--In the Sindh Sports Board Ordinance, 1980, in
section 4--
(1) In
subsection (1.), .after item (ii-a), the following shall be inserted:--
"(ii-a)
Secretary to Government of Sindh, Culture Department. "
(2) for
subsection (2), the following shall be substituted:--
"(2)
The. Secretary, Culture Department and Director of Sports shall also be the
Secretary and Joint Secretary of the Board respectively. ".
